## History

According to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) claimed that God purposely gave [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) red hair. During a series of misadventures in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly served [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) currant wine, leading a furious Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to ban their friendship despite Anne's desperate pleas.
